All The Uproarious Fun Of the Smash Broadway Play!

Free one man to stop one man

Jules Verne Takes You Over the Edge of the World!

Be Brave. Be Bold. Be Free.

Two soldiers of fortune matching wits and guns against the armies of two nations!

38758: A group of college students spend a night at an old, eerie manor, only to realize that a terrifying stalker is watching their every move as he begins plans to repossess an ancient Native American artifact located inside.

No one is safe from the cruel desires of this inhuman fiend!

The runaway begins...

They won because they couldn't lose

A downhill vacation becomes a nightmare of terror. Get off the hill before you get...

You can't keep running forever...because a bullet can travel faster than you can run...

SEX and the DEVIL... A Wicked Combination.

He couldn't resist a pretty face, and every day he fell into a new adventure. Thus he followed the lure of romance until-?

It took a town to beat her down... and a full moon to get revenge.

When the moon is full, the blood tide rises.

He led the last great outlaw raids !

A cry in the night... A gasp in the dark...

The suspense thriller of the year !

You need to know... this time Patrick will kill you.

When theatre and real life become one.
